item.title: iPhone Air 2 Expected Early 2027 with Five New Upgrades
item.description: Apple’s iPhone Air 2 will debut Q1 2027 with a second 48 MP camera, smaller Dynamic Island, A20 Pro 2 nm chip, upgraded N2 Wi‑Fi/BT and C2 5G modem.
